data.name: Help.Faq.first-quote.Question
data.value: How do I make my first quote?

data.name: Help.Faq.first-quote.Answer
data.value: Open Quotes then “New quote”. Pick the customer (create it first in Customers if it does not exist), add lines in the grid, check the checklist on the right, then validate: Lettra gives it its final number.

data.name: Help.Faq.first-quote.Keywords
data.value: create new quote estimate start

data.name: Help.Faq.quote-to-invoice.Question
data.value: How do I turn a quote into an invoice?

data.name: Help.Faq.quote-to-invoice.Answer
data.value: Open the validated quote, mark it “Accepted”, then click “Invoice”. The invoice copies the customer and lines; review it and validate it.

data.name: Help.Faq.quote-to-invoice.Keywords
data.value: convert accept accepted invoice quote

data.name: Help.Faq.fix-invoice.Question
data.value: How do I correct or cancel an invoice already validated?

data.name: Help.Faq.fix-invoice.Answer
data.value: A validated invoice can no longer be changed (that is the law). Open it, click “Credit note” and enter the reason: the credit note cancels all or part of the invoice. Then issue a correct invoice if needed.

data.name: Help.Faq.fix-invoice.Keywords
data.value: mistake edit delete cancel credit note refund

data.name: Help.Faq.payment.Question
data.value: How do I record a payment received?

data.name: Help.Faq.payment.Answer
data.value: In Payments, “Record a payment”: customer, date, amount, payment method, then the invoice(s) it settles. With a bank statement, Bank reconciliation suggests the matching invoices and you confirm.

data.name: Help.Faq.payment.Keywords
data.value: paid transfer cheque settle reconcile bank

data.name: Help.Faq.reminder.Question
data.value: How do I remind a customer who has not paid?

data.name: Help.Faq.reminder.Answer
data.value: Reminders lists overdue unpaid invoices, oldest first. Pick the invoice, review the suggested message and send the reminder; the history keeps every message sent.

data.name: Help.Faq.reminder.Keywords
data.value: late overdue unpaid email due

data.name: Help.Faq.recurring.Question
data.value: How do I invoice automatically every month?

data.name: Help.Faq.recurring.Answer
data.value: In Recurring invoices, create a template: customer, lines, frequency (monthly, quarterly…) and first due date. Lettra prepares each invoice when due; you can pause a template and resume it.

data.name: Help.Faq.recurring.Keywords
data.value: subscription monthly recurring automatic fees

data.name: Help.Faq.customer.Question
data.value: How do I add a customer or a supplier?

data.name: Help.Faq.customer.Answer
data.value: In Customers (or Suppliers), type its name or SIREN: Lettra looks the company up in the public directory and fills the address and VAT number. Complete and save.

data.name: Help.Faq.customer.Keywords
data.value: create new client vendor siren siret address

data.name: Help.Faq.vat.Question
data.value: How do I prepare my VAT return?

data.name: Help.Faq.vat.Answer
data.value: Tax returns computes the draft VAT return (CA3) for the period from invoices and payments, and keeps the calendar of due dates. Lettra files nothing: copy the figures to your tax account online.

data.name: Help.Faq.vat.Keywords
data.value: vat return ca3 tax due date calendar

data.name: Help.Faq.fec.Question
data.value: How do I export the FEC for an audit?

data.name: Help.Faq.fec.Answer
data.value: In FEC, pick the financial year then “Export”. The file follows the format the tax authority expects and a report flags what to check. The Tax audit kit, under Tax returns, gathers the rest.

data.name: Help.Faq.fec.Keywords
data.value: fec export accounting file tax audit accountant

data.name: Help.Faq.dossier.Question
data.value: How do I switch to another dossier?

data.name: Help.Faq.dossier.Answer
data.value: The dossier picker, at the top of the screen, lists the dossiers you can open. Switching reloads the screen with that dossier's data. The Firm overview shows all your dossiers, most urgent first.

data.name: Help.Faq.dossier.Keywords
data.value: dossier company switch firm

data.name: Help.Faq.team.Question
data.value: How do I give a colleague access?

data.name: Help.Faq.team.Answer
data.value: In Team and access (firm administrators only), “Add a person”: a name and an email are enough, then choose what they can do in each dossier.

data.name: Help.Faq.team.Keywords
data.value: colleague user add invite rights access role team permission

data.name: Help.Faq.devices.Question
data.value: How do I get my data on another device?

data.name: Help.Faq.devices.Answer
data.value: Link each device to the firm's server in Firm server: computer, phone and browser then share one database. Without a shared server, each device keeps its own data.

data.name: Help.Faq.devices.Keywords
data.value: device phone tablet computer share sync shared server

data.name: Help.Faq.offline.Question
data.value: Can I work offline?

data.name: Help.Faq.offline.Answer
data.value: The installed app (Windows, Mac, Android, iPhone) works fully offline. In the browser, only drafts are kept offline: they are sent as soon as the connection is back.

data.name: Help.Faq.offline.Keywords
data.value: offline connection internet network plane draft

data.name: Help.Faq.search.Question
data.value: How do I quickly find an invoice or a customer?

data.name: Help.Faq.search.Answer
data.value: Press Ctrl+K (or the magnifier) and type a document number, a customer name or an action such as “new quote Dupont”. For a screen, you can also type a few letters in the search at the top of the menu.

data.name: Help.Faq.search.Keywords
data.value: search find number palette ctrl

data.name: Help.Faq.menu.Question
data.value: How do I set up the menu my way?

data.name: Help.Faq.menu.Answer
data.value: Click a section title to fold or unfold it, and the star next to a screen to pin it in Favourites, at the top of the menu. “Collapse menu”, at the bottom, keeps only the icons. Lettra remembers these settings on this device, for you.

data.name: Help.Faq.menu.Keywords
data.value: menu fold unfold favourites pin star chevron sections

data.name: Help.Faq.voice.Question
data.value: Can I dictate instead of typing?

data.name: Help.Faq.voice.Answer
data.value: Yes: the microphone next to a field (or in the top bar) transcribes your voice. Transcription runs on the device or on the firm's server, never at a third party.

data.name: Help.Faq.voice.Keywords
data.value: voice dictation microphone speak dictate

data.name: Help.Faq.appearance.Question
data.value: How do I change colours or display size?

data.name: Help.Faq.appearance.Answer
data.value: The Appearance button, at the top, offers five themes (including dark and high contrast) and two densities: Comfort for touch, Expert for mouse and keyboard (Ctrl+Shift+D).

data.name: Help.Faq.appearance.Keywords
data.value: theme dark light contrast colours density size font

data.name: Help.Faq.data.Question
data.value: Is my data kept when Lettra is updated?

data.name: Help.Faq.data.Answer
data.value: Yes. Lettra updates never touch your dossiers: invoices, customers and settings stay in place, on the server as in the installed app.

data.name: Help.Faq.data.Keywords
data.value: data lose update backup keep

data.name: Help.Faq.assistant.Question
data.value: What is the AI assistant for?

data.name: Help.Faq.assistant.Answer
data.value: The assistant explains a rule or drafts a quote, which you review and validate yourself: it never validates or sends anything. It is off by default; a firm administrator can turn it on. This help works without it.
